tasks.DefineVariables: Define the variables for the amount of water in both pools before the leaks started.
tasks.FormulateEquations: Formulate algebraic equations to represent the current state of the pools after 4 minutes of leaking.
tasks.SetInitialConditions: Establish initial conditions based on given relationships between the two pools.
tasks.SolveEquations: Solve the formulated equations to find the current volume of water in each pool.
tasks.VerifySolution: Check if the solution satisfies all given conditions.
